title: Star Watcher - Przeprowadzka
brief: Moving-day cutscene bed (text dialogue, no voices). Inspired by the user reference only in tempo, key, mood and instrument roles (cheerful ukulele/funk, pizzicato, marimba, music box); SNES-style samples and lo-fi glue like the other game loops.

sections.intent: packing up: marimba theme over strummed nylon (ukulele role)
theme back, glockenspiel doubles, handclaps: the truck rolls
bridge: music box over half-time drums, a warm look back
full theme with pizzicato counterline, turnaround to the loop
